vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado (IVA) applicable to imports not covered by Annex I of the IVA Code, and, per Article 18º-1 as cited, to the tax generally.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of imposto sobre o valor acrescentado (iva) applicable to imports not covered by annex i of the iva code, and, per article 18-1 as cited, to the tax generally.
vat_rates.rate_basis: customs value plus duties, taxes and accessory costs (commissions, packaging, transport, insurance), excluding IVA itself (Art. 17º-1/2 of the IVA Code)
vat_rates.legal_reference: Código do Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado (IVA), aprovado pela Lei nº 4/22 de 25 de fevereiro, Artigo 18º-1: "As taxas do imposto são as seguintes: para as importações constantes do Anexo I do código do IVA, a taxa é 10%; para as restantes importações, a taxa é 19%; e para as exportações, a taxa é 0%."

vat_rates.legal_product_description: Reduced rate of IVA on imports of goods listed in Annex I of the IVA Code (specific product list not independently extracted in this cycle).
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: reduced rate of iva on imports of goods listed in annex i of the iva code (specific product list not independently extracted in this cycle).
vat_rates.rate_basis: customs value plus duties, taxes and accessory costs, excluding IVA itself (Art. 17º of the IVA Code)
vat_rates.legal_reference: Código do IVA, Lei nº 4/22, Artigo 18º-1, referencing Annex I of the Code. Annex I product list not extracted in this cycle — no HS codes attached.

vat_zero_rated.legal_reference: Código do IVA, Lei nº 4/22, Artigo 18º-1: "para as exportações, a taxa é 0%."
